I am only ten years old, so I help my father on our small millet plot here in the North West. We do not have much money, so we use the manure from our goats and the seed we saved from last harvest. My father says we plant the millet together with cowpea like always, and we weed with our hands because we cannot buy the chemicals. There is no water pump, so we wait for the rains.
